aisearch.ColumnInfo.description: Column information (name and data type) for an index column. Surfaced on `Index.column_info`.

endpoint.description:
The Endpoint resource to create. Fields other than `endpoint.name` carry the desired
configuration; `endpoint.name` is server-assigned from `parent` and `endpoint_id`.

endpoint_id.description:
The user-supplied short name for the Endpoint, per AIP-133. The server composes the
full `Endpoint.name` as `{parent}/endpoints/{endpoint_id}`. AIP-133 does not list
`endpoint_id` as a fields-may-be-required entry, so we annotate it OPTIONAL on the
wire; the server still rejects empty values with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

index.description:
The Index resource to create. Fields other than `index.name` carry the desired
configuration; `index.name` is server-assigned from `parent` and `index_id`.

index_id.description:
The user-supplied Unity Catalog table name for the Index, per AIP-133. The server
composes the full `Index.name` as `{parent}/indexes/{index_id}`. AIP-133 does not
list `index_id` as a fields-may-be-required entry, so we annotate it OPTIONAL on the
wire; the server still rejects empty values with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.

aisearch.CustomTag.description: User-defined key/value tag attached to an AI Search endpoint for cost attribution and access control.

key.description: Key field for an AI Search endpoint tag.

value.description: [Optional] Value field for an AI Search endpoint tag.

aisearch.DataModificationResult.description: Per-row outcome of a data-plane upsert or delete operation.

failed_primary_keys.description: Primary keys of rows that failed to process.

aisearch.DataModificationStatus.description:
Overall outcome of a data-plane upsert or delete. Mirrors the legacy
`databricks.brickindexscheduler.UpsertDeleteDataStatus` value-for-value.

aisearch.DeltaSyncIndexSpec.description: Specification for a Delta Sync index — the index is kept in sync with a source Delta table.

columns_to_sync.description:
[Optional] Select the columns to sync with the index. If left blank, all columns
from the source table are synced. The primary key column and embedding source or
vector column are always synced.

embedding_source_columns.description: The columns that contain the embedding source.

embedding_vector_columns.description: The columns that contain the embedding vectors.

embedding_writeback_table.description: [Optional] Name of the Delta table to sync the index contents and computed embeddings to.

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline that is used to sync the index.

pipeline_type.description:
Pipeline execution mode. Required on create — the backend rejects an unset value.
Storage Optimized endpoints accept only `TRIGGERED`; Standard endpoints accept both.
No explicit `stage` — a REQUIRED field staged below its service would be dropped from
combined specs while remaining in `required`, tripping the OpenAPI required-vs-properties
consistency check. The field inherits the service's launch stage.

source_table.description: The full name of the source Delta table.

aisearch.DirectAccessIndexSpec.description: Specification for a Direct Access index — the customer manages vectors and metadata directly.

embedding_source_columns.description: The columns that contain the embedding source.

embedding_vector_columns.description: The columns that contain the embedding vectors.

schema_json.description:
The schema of the index in JSON format. Supported types are `integer`, `long`,
`float`, `double`, `boolean`, `string`, `date`, `timestamp`. Supported types for
vector columns: `array<float>`, `array<double>`.

aisearch.EmbeddingSourceColumn.description: Name of an embedding source column and its associated embedding model endpoint.

embedding_model_endpoint.description: Name of the embedding model endpoint, used by default for both ingestion and querying.

model_endpoint_name_for_query.description: Name of the embedding model endpoint which, if specified, is used for querying (not ingestion).

aisearch.EmbeddingVectorColumn.description: Name and dimension of an embedding vector column.

budget_policy_id.description: The user-selected budget policy id for the endpoint.

custom_tags.description: The custom tags assigned to the endpoint

effective_budget_policy_id.description: The budget policy id applied to the endpoint

endpoint_type.description: Type of endpoint. Required on create and immutable thereafter.

index_count.description: Number of indexes on the endpoint

last_updated_user.description: User who last updated the endpoint

name.description:
Name of the AI Search endpoint. Server-assigned full resource path
(`workspaces/{workspace}/endpoints/{endpoint}`) on output. On create, the
user-supplied short name is conveyed via `CreateEndpointRequest.endpoint_id`;
the server composes the full `name` and returns it on the response.

replica_count.description:
The client-supplied desired number of replicas for the endpoint, applied at
create/update time. Mutually exclusive with `target_qps`.

target_qps.description:
Target QPS for the endpoint. Mutually exclusive with `replica_count`. Best-effort;
the system does not guarantee this QPS will be achieved.

update_time.description: Time the endpoint was last updated.

usage_policy_id.description: The usage policy id applied to the endpoint.

aisearch.EndpointScalingInfo.description:
Scaling information for a Standard endpoint: the current scaling state, the requested QPS
target, and the progress of an in-progress scaling change.

requested_target_qps.description:
The requested QPS target for the endpoint. Best-effort; the system does not
guarantee this QPS will be achieved.

state.description: The current state of the scaling change request.

aisearch.EndpointStatus.description:
Lifecycle and health state of an AI Search endpoint, along with any human-readable detail
about that state.

message.description: Human-readable detail about the endpoint's current state or the reason for a state transition.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the endpoint. See `State` for the meaning of each value.

aisearch.EndpointStatusState.description: Lifecycle state of an AI Search endpoint, used by both Standard and Storage Optimized SKUs.

aisearch.EndpointThroughputInfo.description: Throughput information for an AI Search endpoint, including requested and current concurrency settings.

change_request_message.description: Additional information about the throughput change request

change_request_state.description: The state of the most recent throughput change request

current_concurrency.description: The current concurrency (total CPU) allocated to the endpoint

current_concurrency_utilization_percenta.description: The current utilization of concurrency as a percentage (0-100)

current_num_replicas.description: The current number of replicas allocated to the endpoint

maximum_concurrency_allowed.description: The maximum concurrency allowed for this endpoint

minimal_concurrency_allowed.description: The minimum concurrency allowed for this endpoint

requested_concurrency.description: The requested concurrency (total CPU) for the endpoint

requested_num_replicas.description: The requested number of replicas for the endpoint

aisearch.FacetResultData.description: Facet aggregation rows returned by a query.

facet_array.description: Facet rows; each row is `[facet_column_name, value_or_range, count]`.

aisearch.Index.description:
An AI Search index — a searchable collection of vectors and metadata hosted on an
AI Search endpoint. Indexes are children of endpoints; customers create, get, list,
and delete them. The `{index}` segment of the resource name is the index's Unity
Catalog table name.

delta_sync_index_spec.description: Specification for a Delta Sync index. Set when `index_type` is `DELTA_SYNC`.

direct_access_index_spec.description: Specification for a Direct Access index. Set when `index_type` is `DIRECT_ACCESS`.

endpoint.description:
Name of the endpoint associated with the index. Ignored on create — the endpoint is
taken from `CreateIndexRequest.parent`; populated only on output.

index_subtype.description: The subtype of the index. Set on create and immutable thereafter.

index_type.description: Type of index. Required on create and immutable thereafter.

name.description:
Name of the AI Search index. Server-assigned full resource path
(`workspaces/{workspace}/endpoints/{endpoint}/indexes/{index}`) on output, where
`{index}` is the index's Unity Catalog table name. On create, the user-supplied UC
table name is conveyed via `CreateIndexRequest.index_id`; the server composes the
full `name` and returns it on the response.

primary_key.description: Primary key of the index. Set on create and immutable thereafter.

aisearch.IndexStatus.description:
Lifecycle and health state of an AI Search index, along with human-readable
detail about that state and basic indexing progress.

index_url.description: Index API URL used to perform operations on the index.

message.description: Human-readable detail about the index's current state.

ready.description: Whether the index is ready for search.

aisearch.IndexSubtype.description:
The subtype of the AI Search index, determining the indexing and retrieval strategy.
- `VECTOR`: Not a supported create value — do not select it. Use `HYBRID` (vector + hybrid
search) or `FULL_TEXT` (full-text only). It is the proto2 default (`= 0`) solely to mirror
the legacy `index_v2.proto` enum value-for-value; it is not an offered index subtype.
- `FULL_TEXT`: An index that uses full-text search without vector embeddings.
- `HYBRID`: An index that uses vector embeddings for similarity search and hybrid search.

enum_descriptions.HYBRID: An index that uses vector embeddings for similarity search and hybrid search.

aisearch.IndexType.description:
There are 2 types of AI Search indexes:
- `DELTA_SYNC`: An index that automatically syncs with a source Delta Table,
automatically and incrementally updating the index as the underlying data in
the Delta Table changes.
- `DIRECT_ACCESS`: An index that supports direct read and write of vectors and
metadata through our REST and SDK APIs. With this model, the user manages
index updates.

Best-effort upper bound on the number of results to return. Honored as an upper
bound by the shim: `page_size` only narrows the legacy backend's response, never
widens it, so the practical cap is `min(page_size, legacy_fixed_page_size)`.

page_token.description: Page token from a previous response. If not provided, returns the first page.

aisearch.ListEndpointsResponse.description: Response for ListEndpoints carrying the page of endpoints and an optional continuation token.

next_page_token.description: A token that can be used to get the next page of results. Empty when there are no more results.

Best-effort upper bound on the number of results to return. Honored as an upper
bound by the shim: `page_size` only narrows the legacy backend's response, never
widens it, so the practical cap is `min(page_size, legacy_fixed_page_size)`.

aisearch.ListIndexesResponse.description: Response for ListIndexes carrying the page of indexes and an optional continuation token.

indexes.description:
The indexes on the endpoint. The field is named `indexes` (not the irregular plural
`indices`) to satisfy core::0132, which derives the response field name from the
ListIndexes method. core::0158::response-plural-first-field independently computes the
resource plural as `indices` and is satisfied via a scoped field exception below.

next_page_token.description: A token that can be used to get the next page of results. Empty when there are no more results.

aisearch.PipelineType.description:
Pipeline execution mode for a Delta Sync index. Required on create for Delta Sync
indexes; the legacy backend rejects an unset value with INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.
- `TRIGGERED`: the pipeline stops after refreshing the source table once, using the
data available when the update started.
- `CONTINUOUS`: the pipeline processes new data as it arrives in the source table to
keep the index fresh.

aisearch.QueryIndexRequest.description:
Request to query (search) an AI Search index. The legacy `num_results` count is exposed as
`max_results`; v1 returns up to `max_results` rows in a single response (no cursor pagination
— see the note on `max_results` below).

columns.description: Column names to include in each result row.

columns_to_rerank.description: Columns whose values are sent to the reranker.

facets.description: Facets to compute over the matched results (e.g. `"category TOP 5"`).

max_results.description:
Maximum number of results to return (the legacy `num_results`). Defaults to 10.
Prefer `page_size`; when both are set, `page_size` takes precedence.

query_columns.description: Text columns to search for `query_text`. When empty, all text columns are searched.

query_text.description: Query text. Required for Delta Sync indexes that compute embeddings from a model endpoint.

query_vector.description:
Query vector. Required for Direct Access indexes and Delta Sync indexes with self-managed
vectors.

reranker.description: If set, results are reranked before being returned.

score_threshold.description: Score threshold for the approximate nearest-neighbor search. Defaults to 0.0.

sort_columns.description: Sort clauses, e.g. `["rating DESC", "price ASC"]`. Overrides relevance ordering.

aisearch.QueryIndexResponse.description: Response for QueryIndex carrying the matched rows and their column metadata.

facet_result.description: Facet aggregation rows, when facets were requested.

aisearch.RemoveDataRequest.description:
Request to remove rows by primary key from a Direct Access AI Search index.
Named RemoveData (not DeleteData) so the linter does not classify it as a standard
AIP-135 Delete method — it deletes rows within an index, not the index resource.

primary_keys.description: Primary keys of the rows to remove.

aisearch.RerankerConfig.description: Configuration for reranking query results with a reranker model.

model.description:
Reranker identifier: "databricks_reranker" for the base model, or a Model Serving
endpoint name when `model_type` is MODEL_TYPE_FINETUNED.

aisearch.RerankerConfigRerankerParameter.description: Parameters controlling how the reranker processes results.

columns_to_rerank.description: Columns whose values are concatenated and sent to the reranker.

aisearch.ResultData.description: The rows of a query result set.

data_array.description: Result rows; each row is a list of column values aligned with the manifest columns.

row_count.description: Number of rows in the result set.

aisearch.ResultManifest.description: Metadata describing the columns of a query result set.

column_count.description: Number of columns in the result set.

columns.description: Information about each column in the result set.

facet_column_count.description: Number of columns in the facet result.

aisearch.ScalingChangeState.description: State of the most recent scaling change request for a Standard endpoint.

aisearch.ScanIndexRequest.description:
Request to scan (paginate over) the rows of an AI Search index. Models the legacy
`num_results` / `last_primary_key` cursor as AIP-158 `page_size` / `page_token`.

page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return in this page.

page_token.description: Page token from a previous response; if unset, scanning starts from the beginning.

aisearch.ScanIndexResponse.description: Response for ScanIndex carrying a page of rows and an optional continuation token.

data.description: The rows in this page, each a struct of column name to value.

next_page_token.description: Token for the next page; empty when the scan is exhausted.

aisearch.SyncIndexRequest.description: Request to synchronize a Delta Sync AI Search index with its source Delta table.

aisearch.SyncIndexResponse.description:
Response for SyncIndex. Empty today; reserved so future sync metadata (e.g. an
operation handle) can be added without breaking the wire contract.

aisearch.ThroughputChangeRequestState.description:
State of the most recent throughput change request issued against a Storage Optimized
endpoint. Surfaced on `EndpointThroughputInfo.change_request_state`.

endpoint.description: The Endpoint resource to update. `endpoint.name` carries the full resource path.

update_mask.description: The list of fields to update.

aisearch.UpsertDataRequest.description: Request to upsert rows into a Direct Access AI Search index.

inputs_json.description: JSON document describing the rows to upsert.
